critical_files.note: Flagged in 4 of 6 dimensions — highest cross-dimension hit rate
3 dimensions — new toolbar buttons and prop threading

findings.title: useEffect overwrites in-progress input on conversation switch
findings.description: The useEffect fires whenever persistedText changes, which happens whenever currentConversationId changes. If the user begins typing before the state settles, the effect overwrites their in-progress text with the previous conversation's persisted value.
findings.impact: Users lose typed text when switching between conversations. Race window exists between user input and the effect's batched state update.
findings.suggestion: Remove the useEffect entirely. Instead, key the component or use the initial state from persistedText on mount only: `useState(() => persistedText)`. Alternatively, compare before overwriting: `if (input === '') setInput(persistedText)`.

findings.title: clearDraft called before send confirmation creates data loss on network failure
findings.description: clearDraft() is called optimistically at send time without waiting for the message to be accepted by the AI backend. If the send fails (network error, rate limit), the draft is already gone from localStorage.
findings.impact: On send failure, users cannot recover their composed message from the draft cache.
findings.suggestion: Move clearDraft() to the success callback of the send operation, or keep a reference to the pre-send text to restore on failure.

findings.title: onOpenKnowledgePanel button always rendered even when prop is undefined
findings.description: The BookmarkPlus button renders unconditionally regardless of whether onOpenKnowledgePanel is provided. Clicking the button when the prop is undefined calls undefined as a function, resulting in a silent no-op (or runtime error in strict mode).
findings.impact: Visible but non-functional button misleads users. Inconsistent with Trash2 and Copy buttons which have conditional render guards.
findings.suggestion: Wrap in conditional: `{onOpenKnowledgePanel && <button onClick={onOpenKnowledgePanel} ...>}`

findings.title: Clipboard writeText called without testing clipboard API availability at runtime
findings.description: The .catch() silences failures, but the try path still executes navigator.clipboard.writeText even in environments where clipboard is undefined (non-HTTPS, some browsers). The catch swallows TypeError silently.
findings.impact: Copy fails silently with no user feedback. No way to distinguish between 'copied' and 'copy failed'.
findings.suggestion: Guard with `if (navigator.clipboard)` before calling, and show a brief toast or visual indicator on success/failure.

findings.title: persistedText initial state ignores conversationId changes after mount
findings.description: useState initializer only runs on mount. Combined with the useEffect at line 129, initial state and the effect compete. If the effect is removed (fixing CORR-001), the initial value becomes stale after conversationId changes.
findings.impact: Correctness of draft restoration depends on which fix is applied to CORR-001.
findings.suggestion: Handle in useDraftCache by returning a stable reload function, or use key={currentConversationId} on the parent to remount.

findings.title: useDraftCache TTL check only runs on load, not on persist
findings.description: The 24-hour TTL is validated when loading a draft (on mount/conversationId change) but not when persisting. If the tab stays open across the TTL boundary, writing continues into an expired entry without refreshing the timestamp.
findings.impact: Draft entries can accumulate past their intended TTL while the app is open.
findings.suggestion: Refresh the TTL metadata timestamp on every persist call, not just on load.

findings.title: Snapshot tests don't validate interactive state changes
findings.description: Snapshot tests capture static rendering but don't verify that interactive states (focus, active, hover) apply correctly. The focus-visible ring changes added by TASK-005 are not asserted through keyboard navigation tests.
findings.impact: Focus ring implementation can regress without snapshot tests catching it.
findings.suggestion: Add keyboard focus simulation tests: `userEvent.tab()` + `expect(button).toHaveClass('focus-visible:ring-2')`.

findings.title: ChatAreaModeControls preset change doesn't reset agent substate in ChatArea
findings.description: Switching between chat/agent presets leaves agentAction state dirty from a previous session.
findings.impact: Minor state inconsistency on mode switch.
findings.suggestion: Reset agentAction in the chatMode setter.

findings.title: latestAssistantContent may be undefined when Copy button shows
findings.description: The guard checks truthiness of lastAssistantContent, but an empty string '' is falsy — button correctly hides. Edge case: content is a whitespace-only string.
findings.impact: Cosmetic — may show copy button for whitespace-only assistant replies.
findings.suggestion: Use `.trim()` in the guard: `{lastAssistantContent?.trim() && ...}`.

findings.title: BookmarkPlus aria-label 'attach context' is inconsistent with feature naming
findings.description: The panel being opened is the KnowledgePanel. 'attach context' implies file attachment, while the panel is for knowledge management.
findings.impact: Screen reader users get an inaccurate label. 'Open knowledge panel' would be more accurate.
findings.suggestion: Change to aria-label="open knowledge panel" and title="Knowledge panel".

findings.title: Trash2 button conditional checks onClearDraft but not current draft state visibility
findings.description: The guard correctly checks both input.length and onClearDraft existence. No correctness bug, but the order of conditions creates a micro-inefficiency.
findings.impact: Cosmetic — onClearDraft should be checked first (cheap) before input.length.
findings.suggestion: Reorder: `{onClearDraft && input.length > 0 && ...}` for short-circuit efficiency.

findings.title: localStorage draft content not size-bounded
findings.description: No maximum size check before writing to localStorage. A very long draft (e.g., pasted content) could push toward browser localStorage limits (typically 5-10MB per origin).
findings.impact: Potential QuotaExceededError on persist() in storage-constrained environments.
findings.suggestion: Add a size check before setItem: truncate or skip persist if text exceeds a threshold (e.g., 50KB).

findings.title: Clipboard receives AI-generated content without sanitization
findings.description: lastAssistantContent is AI-generated text written to the clipboard. If the content contains special characters or OS-level clipboard injection vectors, it could be exploited in certain environments.
findings.impact: Low risk in typical use, but worth noting for security-sensitive deployments.
findings.suggestion: For now, acceptable given the electron/desktop context. Document the assumption.

findings.title: Draft key uses conversationId without normalization
findings.description: If conversationId contains special characters or is user-controlled, the key could potentially collide with other localStorage entries. In practice conversationId is likely a UUID, but this is not enforced.
findings.impact: Low risk given UUID format assumption, but not validated.
findings.suggestion: Validate conversationId format before using as key, or encode it.

findings.title: TTL metadata co-located with draft content in same localStorage value
findings.description: Storing TTL metadata inline with draft text means any corruption of the metadata invalidates the entire entry. Also, savedAt is a timestamp that could be manipulated to extend draft TTL.
findings.impact: Low severity — no practical attack surface in Electron desktop app.
findings.suggestion: Acceptable for current use case. Document the assumption.

findings.title: No input validation on persistedText before rendering as textarea value
findings.description: persistedText comes from localStorage and is set as the textarea value. In a React controlled component, this is safe from XSS (React escapes). Low risk.
findings.impact: No practical XSS risk in React controlled components.
findings.suggestion: No action needed — React controlled component pattern is safe here.

findings.title: Error in localStorage access not handled in persist()
findings.description: If localStorage is unavailable (private browsing in some browsers, storage quota exceeded), persist() will throw. The error is not caught.
findings.impact: App crash or unhandled exception in edge environments.
findings.suggestion: Wrap localStorage calls in try/catch and degrade gracefully.

findings.title: persist() called synchronously on every keystroke
findings.description: persist(v) calls localStorage.setItem synchronously on every single keystroke. localStorage writes are synchronous and can block the main thread, especially for longer drafts or slower devices.
findings.impact: Measurable typing latency on lower-end hardware. Each keystroke triggers a JSON.stringify + localStorage write.
findings.suggestion: Debounce persist with 300-500ms trailing delay. Use useRef-based debounce or useMemo(() => debounce(persist, 350), [persist]).

findings.title: Inline arrow function for onInputChange recreated on every render
findings.description: The inline arrow function is a new reference on every render of ChatArea. ChatAreaComposer receives a new prop reference each time, causing it to re-render even when the actual behavior hasn't changed.
findings.impact: Unnecessary re-renders of ChatAreaComposer on every parent state update.
findings.suggestion: Wrap in useCallback: `const handleInputChange = useCallback((v: string) => { setInput(v); persist(v) }, [persist])`

findings.title: useDraftCache reads localStorage on every conversationId change without debounce
findings.description: Rapid conversation switching (e.g., search through history) triggers a localStorage read on each change. Each read involves JSON.parse on potentially large strings.
findings.impact: Minor performance hit during rapid conversation list navigation.
findings.suggestion: Add a small debounce (50ms) on the conversationId change effect.

findings.title: useLatestAssistantMessageContent runs on every message update
findings.description: This selector re-evaluates on every message change in the conversation, including streaming tokens. The result is passed to ChatAreaComposer causing potential re-renders during streaming.
findings.impact: Extra re-renders during AI response streaming.
findings.suggestion: Memoize the selector or only pass lastAssistantContent when streaming is idle.

findings.title: ChatAreaComposer receives new copyLastReply handler on every render
findings.description: copyLastReply is defined inside ChatAreaComposer as a local function, which is fine. But it captures lastAssistantContent via closure, so it's fresh on every render — this is actually correct behavior.
findings.impact: Minimal — local function definition overhead is negligible.
findings.suggestion: No change needed; the closure capture is intentional here.

findings.title: Transition classes on toolbar buttons add GPU compositing layers
findings.description: All toolbar buttons use `transition-colors` which triggers GPU compositing on hover. With 5+ buttons, each hover creates a layer promotion.
findings.impact: Minor GPU overhead on hover-heavy interactions; negligible on modern hardware.
findings.suggestion: Acceptable for desktop app. If profiling shows GPU issues, group buttons in a single transition container.

findings.title: StoryBiblePanel snapshot captures entire component tree
findings.description: Snapshotting the full StoryBiblePanel container captures hundreds of DOM nodes. Large snapshots slow test serialization and create large .snap files.
findings.impact: Slow snapshot serialization; large .snap file increases test maintenance burden.
findings.suggestion: Snapshot only the section header being tested, not the full component.

findings.title: localStorage.clear() in test beforeEach adds overhead for unrelated tests
findings.description: Global localStorage.clear() in beforeEach runs for all tests in the file, including those that don't use drafts.
findings.impact: Negligible in test environments; listed for completeness.
findings.suggestion: Scope cleanup to only tests that use draft functionality.

findings.title: Three Lucide icons imported without verifying tree-shaking
findings.description: Lucide-react supports tree-shaking, but bundle size impact of 3 new icons should be verified.
findings.impact: Minimal — Lucide icons are individually small (~1KB each).
findings.suggestion: No action needed; Lucide's named exports are tree-shaken by default with modern bundlers.

findings.title: focus-visible ring classes added to 8+ components without batching
findings.description: The focus-visible classes were added individually to each file. No runtime performance impact, but Tailwind will generate matching utilities for each usage.
findings.impact: Negligible CSS size impact; Tailwind deduplicates identical utility classes.
findings.suggestion: Consider extracting to a shared Tailwind `@apply` class or CVA variant for consistency.

findings.title: Draft persistence logic mixed into ChatArea UI component
findings.description: useDraftCache is consumed directly in ChatArea, coupling the persistence concern to the UI layer. The hook usage (when to persist, when to clear) is scattered through ChatArea's render logic and event handlers.
findings.impact: ChatArea must understand persistence lifecycle. Makes ChatArea harder to test in isolation.
findings.suggestion: Wrap in a ChatAreaViewModel or move the draft lifecycle orchestration into useAppShellViewModel.

findings.title: 4-level prop chain for onOpenKnowledgePanel creates fragile wiring
findings.description: Phase 1 threaded onOpenKnowledgePanel through 4 layers: useAppShellViewModel → chatAreaProps in ChatSidebar → ChatArea props → ChatAreaComposer props. Adding any new cross-cutting action requires touching all 4 files.
findings.impact: Brittle — any refactor of the component tree breaks the chain. Violates locality of behavior.
findings.suggestion: Use a panel orchestration context or event bus. ChatAreaComposer dispatches 'togglePanel' events; panel layer responds directly.

findings.title: ChatArea is a 1,269-line god component
findings.description: ChatArea handles streaming, draft persistence, mode switching, tool use, selection, and rendering. Phase 1 added more concerns (draft lifecycle, panel prop threading) to an already oversized component.
findings.impact: Very high maintenance burden. Every feature change risks regression in unrelated areas.
findings.suggestion: Pre-existing issue. Phase 1 additions make it more urgent. Decompose into ChatAreaViewModel hook + focused sub-components.

findings.title: useDraftCache couples storage format to hook interface
findings.description: The hook hardcodes localStorage as the backing store and the JSON serialization format. Changing the storage layer (e.g., to IndexedDB for larger drafts) requires rewriting the hook interface.
findings.impact: Low immediate impact; becomes problematic when draft sizes grow (longer documents, file attachments).
findings.suggestion: Introduce a StorageAdapter interface that localStorage implements. The hook depends on the interface, not the implementation.

findings.title: ChatAreaComposer toolbar mixes knowledge panel concerns with draft concerns
findings.snippet: // BookmarkPlus, Trash2, Copy all in same toolbar row
findings.description: The toolbar now hosts actions from 3 different concerns: knowledge attachment (BookmarkPlus), draft management (Trash2), and conversation history (Copy). These have no architectural grouping.
findings.impact: Toolbar will grow unbounded as more features add buttons. No clear ownership model.
findings.suggestion: Define toolbar slot sections (e.g., context-actions, draft-actions, history-actions) with explicit ownership.

findings.title: ChatAreaModeControls simplification removed valid extension points
findings.description: TASK-003 removed the advanced section and props. If future modes require per-mode sub-settings, the extension mechanism no longer exists.
findings.impact: Future mode additions require re-adding removed infrastructure.
findings.suggestion: The simplification is correct for now. Document the removed capability as a deferred item in the roadmap.

findings.title: Snapshot tests create architectural coupling to rendering details
findings.description: Snapshot tests capture the full DOM structure. Any CSS class change, element restructuring, or prop addition will fail the snapshot — coupling test maintenance to unrelated UI changes.
findings.impact: High test maintenance churn as the codebase evolves. Snapshots become obstacles rather than safety nets.
findings.suggestion: Replace full-container snapshots with targeted assertions: `expect(button).toHaveClass(...)`, `expect(header).toHaveTextContent(...)`.

findings.title: Temporal coupling between persistedText load and input state initialization
findings.description: The initial state depends on persistedText which comes from a localStorage read in useDraftCache. The initialization order creates implicit temporal coupling — the draft must load before state initialization.
findings.impact: Subtle but important ordering dependency that's not documented.
findings.suggestion: Document the initialization contract, or make it explicit with a loading state in useDraftCache.

findings.title: No abstraction between toolbar button actions and their side effects
findings.description: Each toolbar button handler is defined inline in the component, directly calling browser APIs and prop callbacks. No action abstraction layer exists.
findings.impact: Testing toolbar behavior requires mounting the full component. No unit-testable action layer.
findings.suggestion: Extract toolbar action handlers to a useComposerActions hook that takes props and returns handlers.

findings.title: globals.css :root tokens not consumed as CSS custom properties in components
findings.description: The new composer tokens in globals.css are documentation anchors but are not referenced by any Tailwind class or component. Tailwind's JIT compiler doesn't pick up CSS custom properties from globals.css for arbitrary values.
findings.impact: Tokens serve as design documentation only. No runtime enforcement of their usage.
findings.suggestion: Either extend tailwind.config.ts to reference the tokens, or accept them as documentation-only and comment accordingly.

findings.title: ChatArea.tsx at 1,269 lines exceeds maintainable size threshold
findings.description: Phase 1 added ~50 lines to ChatArea (useDraftCache, persist, clearDraft, new prop, latestAssistantContent). The file was already at maintainability limit before Phase 1.
findings.impact: Every change requires reading the entire file to avoid regression. Cognitive load is extremely high.
findings.suggestion: Priority decomposition target for next phase: extract ChatAreaViewModel, ChatAreaToolbar, ChatAreaSendHandler.

findings.title: localStorage key magic string 'niko.draft:' not extracted to constant
findings.description: The key prefix 'niko.draft:' is a magic string hardcoded inline. If this prefix needs to change (e.g., versioning, namespace change), it must be found and changed in code.
findings.impact: Key name drift risk. Also not visible to other modules that might need to enumerate or clear draft keys.
findings.suggestion: Extract to: `export const DRAFT_KEY_PREFIX = 'niko.draft:'`

findings.title: New toolbar buttons lack focus-visible classes unlike other interactive elements
findings.description: TASK-005/006 added focus-visible:ring-2 to all other interactive elements. The 3 new toolbar buttons added in TASK-002 do not have focus-visible classes, creating inconsistency within the same file.
findings.impact: Keyboard navigation inconsistency. Users tabbing through toolbar buttons get no focus indicator on the 3 new buttons.
findings.suggestion: Add `focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary-500/50` to all 3 new button elements.

findings.title: globals.css lacks section comments for new token block
findings.description: The token block has a single comment but is not separated with a clear visual boundary from the sidebar tokens above. As globals.css grows, locating specific token groups becomes harder.
findings.impact: Minor maintainability issue; not critical but accumulates technical debt.
findings.suggestion: Add a blank line before and after the new block, and follow the existing comment style of other token groups.

findings.title: ChatArea draft lifecycle (persist/clear/restore) is undocumented in-code
findings.description: The contract between ChatArea and useDraftCache (when to persist, when to clear, what happens on conversationId change) is not documented anywhere. Future maintainers must trace the entire component to understand the lifecycle.
findings.impact: High risk of introducing CORR-001-class bugs when modifying conversation switching logic.
findings.suggestion: Add a brief contract comment above the useDraftCache line: the 3 lifecycle moments (mount restore, keystroke persist, send clear).

findings.title: ChatAreaComposer props interface has grown to 13+ optional props
findings.description: Phase 1 added 3 new optional props (onOpenKnowledgePanel, onClearDraft, lastAssistantContent). The interface now has 13+ props, making it harder to understand which props are required vs optional.
findings.impact: High cognitive load when consuming ChatAreaComposer. Unclear which props must be wired.
findings.suggestion: Group props by concern (required vs optional) or split into sub-interfaces.

findings.title: useDraftCache TTL value (24h in ms) is a magic number
findings.description: The 24-hour TTL is computed inline as a magic number. If the TTL needs to change, the value must be tracked down in the hook implementation.
findings.impact: Minor — but configuration values should be named constants.
findings.suggestion: Extract: `const DRAFT_TTL_MS = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000 // 24 hours`

findings.title: Focus-visible classes duplicated as string literals across 8+ component files
findings.description: TASK-005/006 copy-pasted the focus ring class string into 8+ files. Any change to the focus ring style (color, width) requires finding and updating each occurrence.
findings.impact: High duplication, inconsistency risk when updating focus style.
findings.suggestion: Extract to a shared Tailwind component class via `@apply` in globals.css, or use a CVA variant: `const focusRing = 'focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary-500/50'`

findings.title: ChatAreaModeControls simplification not documented as intentional
findings.description: The removal of showAdvanced, onSetChatMode, and the advanced section was intentional scope reduction. Without a comment, future devs may try to 're-fix' it by adding back the removed functionality.
findings.impact: Risk of reverting intentional simplification.
findings.suggestion: Add a brief comment: `// Intentionally simplified to presets-only; advanced mode removed in P1 UX simplification`

findings.title: Test assertions use string aria-labels that can drift from implementation
findings.description: Tests query by aria-label string 'attach context'. If the label changes (see CORR-010), the test fails with a confusing error rather than a clear refactoring signal.
findings.impact: Test maintenance friction on label changes.
findings.suggestion: Export the label strings as constants from the component file and import in tests.

findings.title: AppContextFooter has no dedicated test file
findings.description: AppContextFooter.tsx was modified (TASK-005 added focus-visible classes) but has no test coverage. The incorrect focus-visible classes (BP-004) went undetected.
findings.impact: Regressions in AppContextFooter are undetectable.
findings.suggestion: Add AppContextFooter.test.tsx with: renders null when empty string, renders content, does NOT have tabIndex or focus role.

findings.title: Sidebar snapshot test will become stale as navigation items change
findings.description: The Sidebar snapshot captures the full navigation tree. Adding or removing nav items will fail the snapshot, making the snapshot a merge conflict magnet.
findings.impact: Every navigation change breaks the snapshot test.
findings.suggestion: Replace with targeted assertions on the focus-visible behavior that TASK-005 introduced.

findings.title: clearDraft and persist return types not documented in hook interface
findings.description: The hook's return type is inferred but not explicitly declared. persist and clearDraft return void, but this is not explicit in the type signature.
findings.impact: Minor — TypeScript infers correctly but explicit types aid IDE hover documentation.
findings.suggestion: Add explicit return type: `): { persistedText: string; persist: (text: string) => void; clearDraft: () => void }`

findings.title: ChatArea.test.tsx stale test cleanup not documented
findings.snippet: // 5 pre-existing test failures fixed in TASK-007
findings.description: TASK-007 fixed 5 pre-existing test failures in ChatArea.test.tsx but the nature of each fix is not documented in the test file. Future devs may re-introduce the removed test cases.
findings.impact: Risk of re-introducing tests for removed functionality.
findings.suggestion: Add a comment block noting which tests were removed and why (or reference the TASK-007 commit).

findings.title: Section header normalization applied inconsistently across knowledge tabs
findings.description: TASK-004 normalized section headers in StoryBiblePanel.tsx, PersistedEntityTab.tsx, and SkillTab.tsx. If other tabs exist (EventTab, ThemeTab, etc.), they may still use the old style.
findings.impact: Visual inconsistency if other tabs not covered by TASK-004 were missed.
findings.suggestion: Audit all knowledge tab components for section header consistency.

findings.title: AiToolbar and MessageBubble focus rings use slightly different opacity values
findings.description: Minor inconsistency in focus ring opacity between components. Some use /50, others may use different values.
findings.impact: Cosmetic inconsistency.
findings.suggestion: Standardize all to /50 as part of a future focus system cleanup.

findings.title: title attributes duplicate aria-label values on toolbar buttons
findings.description: Both aria-label and title are set to identical values. title is redundant when aria-label is present.
findings.impact: Redundant attributes; minor HTML bloat.
findings.suggestion: Remove title attributes where aria-label is already set.

findings.title: Dark mode color overrides incomplete for sidebar tokens
findings.description: globals.css defines --sidebar-bg and --sidebar-text in :root but only partially overrides them in .dark. The composer tokens added in Phase 1 also lack dark mode variants.
findings.impact: Minor — dark mode may use light-mode sidebar colors in some contexts.
findings.suggestion: Audit :root token declarations and ensure every token has a .dark override.

findings.title: useEffect for syncing state from props is a React anti-pattern
findings.description: The React docs explicitly discourage using useEffect to sync state from props/derived values. This creates a render cycle: render → effect fires → setState → re-render. The key prop pattern or lazy initializer is the idiomatic solution.
findings.impact: Anti-pattern that creates subtle bugs (CORR-001) and unnecessary render cycles.
findings.suggestion: Use lazy state initializer: `useState(() => persistedText)` and reset via key prop on conversation change.

findings.title: No visual feedback after clipboard copy action
findings.description: The Copy button provides no visual feedback (icon change, tooltip, toast) after a successful copy. Users have no confirmation that the action completed.
findings.impact: Poor UX — user clicks Copy and nothing visible happens. Standard practice is to show a checkmark or brief toast.
findings.suggestion: Add transient state: `const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false)` — flip to true on success, revert after 1.5s. Show CheckIcon when copied.

findings.title: clearDraft called unconditionally on send even when no draft exists
findings.description: clearDraft() performs a localStorage.removeItem call on every send, even when there was no draft. This is a no-op functionally but represents an unnecessary localStorage mutation.
findings.impact: Minor — localStorage.removeItem on missing key is safe. Represents an unnecessary side effect.
findings.suggestion: Guard with: `if (persistedText) clearDraft()` — only clear if a draft exists.

findings.title: focus-visible ring applied to non-interactive div in AppContextFooter
findings.description: TASK-005 added focus-visible classes to the AppContextFooter outer div. Divs are not focusable by default — focus-visible classes on non-interactive elements never trigger in browsers without tabIndex. The classes are dead code and misleading.
findings.impact: Dead CSS classes that mislead developers into thinking the element is interactive. Could cause confusion when adding tabIndex in the future.
findings.suggestion: Remove the three focus-visible classes from AppContextFooter's div. No other changes needed.

findings.title: Trash2 button appears and disappears without animation as user types/deletes
findings.description: The Trash2 button pops into and out of existence as the user types the first character or deletes the last. This creates a jarring layout shift in the toolbar.
findings.impact: Noticeable UI jank when starting to type or clearing the input.
findings.suggestion: Use CSS opacity/scale transition on mount/unmount: render always but control visibility with `opacity-0 pointer-events-none` when hidden.

findings.title: BookmarkPlus button missing disabled state and feedback for unavailable contexts
findings.description: The button is always active with no disabled state. There may be contexts where the knowledge panel is not available (e.g., no conversation active). No visual affordance for unavailability.
findings.impact: Clicking in unavailable states produces no feedback.
findings.suggestion: Add disabled prop: `disabled={!onOpenKnowledgePanel}` + conditional styles. Also fix the conditional render (CORR-003).

findings.title: Missing aria-live region for draft-restored notification
findings.description: When a draft is restored on conversation switch, there is no accessible announcement. Screen reader users have no way to know their previous draft was loaded.
findings.impact: Accessibility gap for screen reader users.
findings.suggestion: Add an aria-live='polite' region that announces 'Draft restored' when persistedText is loaded.

findings.title: Copy button missing aria-pressed state to indicate copy success
findings.description: After copy, the button provides no state change signal to assistive technologies. aria-pressed or a status announcement would improve accessibility.
findings.impact: Screen reader users cannot confirm copy action completed.
findings.suggestion: Add aria-pressed={copied} and update aria-label to 'copied!' after success for 1.5s.

findings.title: QuickPanel search input missing autocomplete=off
findings.description: Search inputs generally should have autocomplete='off' to prevent browser autofill from interfering with quick-switch functionality.
findings.impact: Browser may show autofill dropdown over quick panel results.
findings.suggestion: Add autocomplete='off' to the QuickPanel search input.

findings.title: AiToolbar disabled state uses CSS cursor but lacks aria-disabled
findings.description: TASK-006 added disabled:cursor-not-allowed to AiToolbar buttons. HTML disabled attribute is present but aria-disabled is not explicitly set for assistive technologies that don't infer from HTML disabled.
findings.impact: Minor accessibility gap — most screen readers handle HTML disabled correctly.
findings.suggestion: Add aria-disabled={true} to match HTML disabled for maximum compatibility.

findings.title: MessageBubble focus rings applied to 4 buttons without testing keyboard navigation
findings.description: TASK-006 added focus rings to 4 MessageBubble buttons but no test verifies keyboard navigation through them (tab order, focus management after action).
findings.impact: Focus rings present but untested — keyboard users may encounter unexpected focus behavior.
findings.suggestion: Add keyboard navigation tests for MessageBubble action buttons.

findings.title: ChatSidebar ComponentProps spread passes all ChatArea props without type filtering
findings.description: ChatSidebar accepts chatAreaProps typed as ComponentProps<typeof ChatArea> and spreads them. This passes ALL ChatArea props (including internal ones) to ChatSidebar consumers, creating an implicit coupling.
findings.impact: Adding props to ChatArea automatically exposes them through ChatSidebar's interface.
findings.suggestion: Define an explicit ChatSidebarProps interface that only includes the props ChatSidebar consumers need to configure.

findings.title: Sidebar active highlight uses non-semantic brand colors instead of semantic tokens
findings.description: TASK-005 updated the active state highlight. The classes use raw Tailwind primary palette values instead of semantic design tokens (which would be more maintainable for theme changes).
findings.impact: Changing the app's active color requires updating every instance of these classes.
findings.suggestion: Define semantic CSS custom properties like `--color-active-bg` and `--color-active-text` in globals.css and use them via arbitrary values.

findings.title: Snapshot tests lack update instructions in test file
findings.description: The snapshot tests added in TASK-008 will fail after legitimate UI changes. There's no comment or documentation in the test file about how to update snapshots intentionally.
findings.impact: Developers unfamiliar with Vitest snapshot updates may be confused when snapshots fail.
findings.suggestion: Add a comment: `// Update snapshots with: pnpm test -- --update-snapshots`

findings.title: --composer-focus-ring token missing dark mode override
findings.description: TASK-001 added --composer-focus-ring to :root with the light mode primary color value. The .dark block does not override this token. In dark mode, if any component references --composer-focus-ring, it will use the light mode value, potentially resulting in an invisible or incorrect focus ring color.
findings.impact: Future components that consume --composer-focus-ring will have incorrect dark mode focus ring colors until discovered.
findings.suggestion: Add to .dark block: `--composer-focus-ring: rgba(167, 139, 250, 0.5);` (violet-400 at 50% for dark mode contrast).

findings.title: BookmarkPlus icon semantic mismatch with 'attach context' action
findings.description: BookmarkPlus is a 'save to bookmarks' icon. The intended action is opening the knowledge/context panel. This creates a semantic disconnect — users familiar with standard iconography expect bookmark actions, not panel toggles.
findings.impact: User confusion about the button's purpose.
findings.suggestion: Consider Library, Database, or StickyNote icon (Lucide) for knowledge-related actions. Or use Layers/Files for 'context'.

findings.title: onOpenKnowledgePanel naming doesn't follow established toggle/open/close conventions
findings.description: The prop is named onOpenKnowledgePanel but the implementation toggles (opens AND closes) the panel. The name suggests open-only, but behavior is toggle.
findings.impact: Misleading prop name creates maintenance confusion.
findings.suggestion: Rename to onToggleKnowledgePanel throughout the prop chain.

findings.title: ChatAreaModeControls simplification not reflected in consuming component tests
findings.description: The test file was updated as part of TASK-003, but no tests explicitly verify that the removed advanced section is gone (negative assertions).
findings.impact: If advanced section is accidentally re-added, tests won't catch it.
findings.suggestion: Add: `expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: /show less|show advanced/i })).not.toBeInTheDocument()`

findings.title: globals.css new token block missing trailing blank line
findings.description: The new composer token block ends at line 56 without a trailing blank line before the closing `}` of :root. Minor formatting inconsistency.
findings.impact: Cosmetic — no functional impact.
findings.suggestion: Add blank line after the last token for consistency with other grouped token blocks.

findings.title: Sidebar active state test assertions check class names, not visual output
findings.description: Tests checking for Tailwind class names are brittle — renaming or restructuring the active state implementation breaks tests without a real regression.
findings.impact: Test maintenance friction on styling changes.
findings.suggestion: Consider visual regression tests or aria-current assertions instead of className checks.

findings.title: No scroll-behavior or overflow handling on QuickPanel with focus ring
findings.description: The focus ring added to QuickPanel's search input may be clipped if the panel has overflow:hidden. Not confirmed, but worth checking.
findings.impact: Potential clipped focus ring in QuickPanel.
findings.suggestion: Verify QuickPanel has ring-offset or overflow-visible on the focus ring container.

findings.title: AppHeader toggle button focus ring uses primary-500 while ChatSidebar uses same — consistent but not verified in theme
findings.description: Minor note: all focus rings use primary-500/50 consistently after Phase 1. This is correct and intentional.
findings.impact: No issue — positive confirmation of consistency.
findings.suggestion: No action needed.

findings.title: useDraftCache not exported from hooks barrel file (if one exists)
findings.description: If the project uses a hooks barrel (src/hooks/index.ts), useDraftCache may not be added to it, requiring consumers to import from the full path.
findings.impact: Minor DX inconsistency — no functional impact.
findings.suggestion: Add to hooks barrel if one exists.

deep_dives.root_cause: useEffect with [persistedText] dependency fires whenever conversationId changes, which triggers a re-read of useDraftCache. The effect's setInput call races with any in-progress user typing — React batches the state update, overwriting the user's partial input with the just-loaded persisted text.

remediation.approach: Remove the useEffect entirely. Use lazy state initializer for mount. Reset on conversation change via key prop or by only applying persistedText when input is empty.

deep_dives.risk_if_unfixed: Users lose typed text when switching conversations. Severity increases with typing speed.

deep_dives.root_cause: BookmarkPlus button onClick={onOpenKnowledgePanel} executes unconditionally. When onOpenKnowledgePanel is undefined (e.g., when ChatAreaComposer is used without the knowledge panel wired), the onClick fires undefined() which is a no-op in non-strict mode. Unlike Trash2 and Copy which have {condition && <button>} guards, BookmarkPlus lacks this pattern.

remediation.approach: Add conditional render matching the pattern used by Trash2 and Copy.

deep_dives.risk_if_unfixed: Dead/misleading UI element. Any context where ChatAreaComposer is rendered without onOpenKnowledgePanel will show a non-functional button.

deep_dives.root_cause: localStorage.setItem is synchronous on the main thread. Called on every keypress via the inline handler (v) => { setInput(v); persist(v) }, it blocks React's state batching and can cause measurable input lag on lower-end hardware or when draft content is large (>10KB).

remediation.approach: Debounce the persist call with a 350ms trailing delay. The debounce should be stable across renders using useRef or useMemo.

deep_dives.risk_if_unfixed: Input latency especially noticeable when typing fast on lower-end hardware or under system load.

deep_dives.root_cause: The arrow function (v) => { setInput(v); persist(v) } is created as a new reference on each render of ChatArea. ChatAreaComposer receives onInputChange as a prop — if ChatAreaComposer ever uses React.memo, this new reference defeats memoization. Even without memo, it signals an opportunity to stabilize.

remediation.approach: Wrap in useCallback. Note: depends on PERF-001 fix (debounced persist) since persist's reference must be stable.

deep_dives.risk_if_unfixed: Unnecessary re-renders of ChatAreaComposer on any ChatArea state update.

deep_dives.root_cause: Phase 1 added a feature (knowledge panel toggle) by threading the handler through the existing prop chain. The chain passes through 4 layers: useAppShellViewModel (creates handler) → chatAreaProps object in ChatSidebar → ChatArea prop interface → ChatAreaComposer prop interface. Each intermediate layer is unaware of the feature's intent.

remediation.approach: Use a PanelContext that ChatAreaComposer can consume directly, bypassing the prop chain.

deep_dives.risk_if_unfixed: Every new cross-cutting action (e.g., open template panel from composer) requires touching 4 files. Creates fragile coupling.

deep_dives.root_cause: TASK-005 added focus-visible:ring-2 to AppContextFooter's outer div along with other interactive element updates. The div is not focusable (no tabIndex, no role='button'), so focus-visible:ring-2 is unreachable CSS. The classes were likely added by pattern-matching without verifying the element type.

remediation.approach: Remove the three focus-visible utility classes from the div. No other change needed.

deep_dives.risk_if_unfixed: Dead classes that mislead future developers. Risk of someone adding tabIndex=0 to 'activate' the already-present focus ring, inadvertently making a non-interactive element focusable.

deep_dives.root_cause: TASK-001 added 6 CSS custom properties to :root. The --composer-focus-ring value uses rgba(114, 64, 221, 0.5) — the primary-500 color at 50% opacity, which is the light mode primary color. The .dark block was not updated to override this value with the dark mode primary color (violet-400).

remediation.approach: Add the dark mode override to the .dark block. Reassessed to medium severity since the token is not yet consumed.
remediation.code_example:
// In .dark block (around line 59):
--composer-focus-ring: rgba(167, 139, 250, 0.5); /* violet-400 at 50% for dark mode */

deep_dives.risk_if_unfixed: Any component that consumes --composer-focus-ring in dark mode will use the light mode color, potentially resulting in poor focus ring contrast.
deep_dives.note: Severity downgraded from high to medium: token is not currently consumed by any component, so immediate user impact is zero.
